claims.statement: AuthService hashes passwords with bcryptjs (10 salt rounds), embeds a per-account tokenKey inside issued JWTs (14d for admins, 7d for collection users), caches verified tokenKeys for 30s in an LRU cache (max 5000 entries), and invalidates sessions immediately when passwords change or revokeAdminSessions/revokeRecordSessions rotates tokenKey.

OAuthProviderRegistry manages Google, GitHub, Discord, Microsoft, and Apple providers, generates 10-minute PKCE S256 sessions in listAuthMethods, and immediately consumes and validates state, provider, collection, redirectUri, and codeVerifier in validateAndConsumeState.

AuthService.authenticateOAuth2 requires a verified provider email before auto-linking an existing user account by email, and enforces EventBus before/after hooks, RecordValidator field constraints, and collection createRule checks when provisioning new OAuth2 users.

ApiKeyService issues keys in the format nsk_<env>_<keyId>_<secretEntropy>, stores only the SHA-256 secretHash and keyPrefix in _api_keys, verifies secrets using crypto.timingSafeEqual, enforces expiration and IP allowlists, and flushes usage metrics in batches every 5 seconds.

AuthMiddleware authenticates API keys from x-api-key or Authorization headers and JWTs from Authorization Bearer or ?token query parameters, granting full admin bypass only to admin JWTs or API keys with role admin or * / admin:* scopes while enforcing both hasScope and collection rules on non-admin API keys.

RuleEngine evaluates collection access rules with admin bypass, null (admin-only), empty string (public), and boolean/comparison expressions over @request.auth, @request.data, @request.query, and record fields, while buildListFilter compiles row-level comparisons into SQL filter strings and RuleBuilder parses, validates, and serializes rule expressions.
